old_problem: Procedure mixes Type 27 cooling-device metadata with Type 3 chassis fields. Prior review left mapping pending although DMTF defines it. DeepSeek cannot prove Type 28 probe linkage, cooling-group membership, type/status or nominal-speed sentinel semantics from a heading grep, and static metadata cannot prove live RPM or cooling response.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict. DMTF maps the cooling fields to Type 27, its Temperature Probe Handle to Type 28, and the listed chassis fields to Type 3. All branches remain mandatory. Exact device/probe/group matrix, speed encoding and optionality are fail-closed Project Configuration. Validation remains read-only metadata; fan RPM accuracy and thermal response require separate coverage.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1939, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 1940 / Wistron-BIOS-00482-V002 / 53e4d6493c2324d2.
DMTF field ownership removes the Type 27 versus Type 3 ambiguity without deleting any listed field.
Every non-sentinel Type 27 Temperature Probe Handle must resolve to the expected Type 28 record; cooling group, device type/status, description and OEM metadata are checked together.
Nominal Speed raw encoding and unknown sentinel are preserved; a printed value is metadata and not proof of measured RPM.
One approved warm reboot requires same-target Boot ID and OS Ready; complete structures and logs are preserved before/after.
No dmidecode, SSH, reboot, log-clear, fan/thermal control, firmware, SMBIOS or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: SMBIOS Type 27 cooling topology, Type 28 probe linkage and Type 3 persistence
test_case.purpose: Verify the complete Type 27 cooling-device population, Type 28 probe references, groups, type/status, nominal-speed metadata and listed Type 3 chassis fields against exact matrices before and after reboot without active cooling claims.
required_package: Exact target/BIOS/SMBIOS identity and Type 27 matrix: device count, descriptions, types/statuses, groups, OEM values, raw nominal-speed encoding/sentinel policy
Authoritative Type 28 handle/probe map and physical cooling-device-to-probe relationship
Validated dmidecode and complete Type 27/28/3 parser with raw encodings, handles, stderr/status and protected evidence
Secure access, approved OS warm reboot/window/Boot ID timeout, preserved logs and independent recovery
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY COLLECTION AROUND ONE APPROVED REBOOT; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind target identity and preserve logs. Securely save complete `dmidecode --type 27`, referenced `--type 28`, and `--type 3` output/status. For every Type 27 record validate unique identity, type/status, cooling group, OEM/description and raw/decoded nominal speed; resolve every applicable probe handle to the approved Type 28 map; separately validate Type 3. After one approved OS warm reboot with Boot ID/OS Ready proof, repeat and semantic-diff. Do not clear logs, alter fan/PWM/thermal/firmware/SMBIOS state, expose secrets, retry or claim live RPM/thermal behavior.
test_case.expected_result: Every expected Type 27 device is present once with correct type/status, group, description, OEM and nominal-speed metadata, and every applicable Temperature Probe Handle resolves to the correct Type 28 probe. Type 3 fields are correct. All remain stable after OS Ready with no thermal/platform-health regression.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete successful pre/post Type 27/28/3 evidence, exact population and all handle/group/status/speed/chassis checks, approved Boot ID-changing reboot and OS Ready. FAIL on missing/duplicate device, orphan/wrong probe, wrong group/type/status/speed semantics, companion mismatch or reboot/health failure. NOT READY covers missing matrices/access/recovery. Header-only output or live cooling claims cannot PASS; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Read-only metadata only; never change fan PWM/policy, thermal thresholds, BIOS, SMBIOS or firmware.
Preserve complete raw encodings/logs and protect identity/OEM values; never clear logs or suppress errors.
Use secure verified access and approved reboot/recovery; no plaintext secrets or disabled host verification.
Stop on wrong target, orphan handle, thermal anomaly or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant, target/BIOS/SMBIOS/dmidecode/parser identity and Type 27, Type 28 and Type 3 matrices
Complete pre/post Type 27/28/3 raw output/status and hashes
Per-device identity/type/status/group/speed plus Type 28 handle resolution
Approved reboot timeline, Boot IDs, same-target OS Ready and preserved logs/thermal health
No-active-cooling-claim/no-clear/no-write/no-retry audit, workload restore and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On reboot failure preserve first evidence and use only approved console/BMC recovery. On missing device, orphan probe or metadata drift, preserve complete SMBIOS/firmware identity, make no fan/thermal/BIOS change and escalate. Do not auto-reboot or adjust cooling controls to force alignment.
